entry_item.definition: v.i. a) (Of physical motion tram inside to outside or upward). To go or come out, emerge, leave; to climb, ascend; to pass over, across, or through; (very frequently added to other verbs of motion, as to go, come, fly, etc. to qualify motion). b) To appear, show, occur, happen, take place, eventuate, break out. c) Idiomatic uses.

example.definition: Modal converb of γar-. See also separate entry.
To leave the home or family; to become a monk.
For oil to come out, appear, or be produced.
For smoke to come out or be produced.
For danger or an accident to occur.
For a war to break out.
For a sore or ulcer to break out; to have syphilis.
For the color to come off or fade.
For a path to be trodden; for a road to open up (actually or figuratively).
T. hbyin par hos pa; S. nih-saraniya. Leading to riddance (of evil qualities)-ED 310 a.
